title: Omnibusonderzoek Gemeente Haarlem 1997 - VSO
authors: Canisius, M.J.M., Breed, H.M., Molenaar, W., Spruyt, M.E., Gemeente Haarlem * Haarlem, Onderzoek en Statistiek (primary investigator)
contributors: Gemeente HaarlemBureau Onderzoek en Statistiek (data collector)
descriptions: Survey among inhabitants of Haarlem concerning several aspects of the municipal policy. R.'s opinion about having office hours for vaccination of travellers / live on r.'s income / City Bank of Haarlem / living environment in the centre of the city / opening of shops at sunday / quality improvement of the district of Schalkwijk / possibility of buying homes which were originally rented by inhabitants / attractiveness of Haarlem / parking / public toilets / parking facilities for bicycles / municipal service / municipal archives / safety / used media for information about Haarlem / role of district councils / recreational issues / use of cultural facilities / environmental issues / green space planning / maintenance of city districts / Ecoteams. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ politics/ consumption of durables
